interpretation_limits: This is the declared final local development iteration for the current two-sphere geometry concept.
A PASS is development evidence only; sealed holdout validation remains mandatory before profile creation or promotion.
Every detector candidate has exactly two spheres: one heel and one forefoot.
The nine unique detector spheres in each offline batch are shared placement samples for ten independent two-sensor pairs, not a nine-sensor runtime detector.
The mesh is used only offline for sphere placement and geometric pre-gates.
Thresholds 0.5/0.25 N, dwell 30 ms, FSM, timing gates, primary load evidence, and event-guard routing are unchanged.
Toe recontact remains a separate foot-clearance diagnostic; detector validity requires at least 30 ms causal clear before the next accepted HS onset.
The runtime RL load-routing gap remains unresolved, so a development winner is not promotable or deployable.
No policy, training, rollout, runtime default, FSM, active profile, or sealed data is modified or evaluated.
objective: Perform one final local extrapolation from the V8 best candidate, using slightly deeper and more anterior heel placements to close its three-sample transfer gap and recover its 1.469 ms HS overrun, with only a F79/F79.5 comparison at fixed P35. Every detector remains exactly one heel plus one forefoot sphere.
